d: India has successfully conducted a user trial of the Agni-IV ballistic missile, validating its operational readiness under the Strategic Forces Command. The solid-fuel missile has a range of up to 4,000 kilometres, can carry conventional or nuclear payloads, and is launched from a road-mobile platform. Meanwhile, India's northeastern state of Assam is reeling after devastating floods. Almost 100 people have died due to the flooding, and over 168,000 have been affected.
